package io.github.dsheirer.module.decode.p25.phase1;

import io.github.dsheirer.dsp.filter.FilterFactory;
import io.github.dsheirer.dsp.filter.decimate.DecimationFilterFactory;
import io.github.dsheirer.dsp.filter.decimate.IRealDecimationFilter;
import io.github.dsheirer.dsp.filter.fir.FIRFilterSpecification;
import io.github.dsheirer.dsp.filter.fir.real.IRealFilter;
import io.github.dsheirer.dsp.symbol.Dibit;
import io.github.dsheirer.module.decode.DecoderType;
import io.github.dsheirer.module.decode.FeedbackDecoder;
import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

/**
 * Oracle for the LSM (CQPSK) chain: the exact filter chain of P25P1DecoderLSM.receive() at a 50 kHz channel rate,
 * feeding the real P25P1DemodulatorLSM with a stub framer that records every symbol.
 * Input: synthetic pi/4-DQPSK at 4800 baud, 50 kHz, with carrier offset and noise.
 *
 * Lines:
 *   TAPS|baseband|hex...      TAPS|rrc|hex...
 *   BLOCK|i hex|q hex|symbols  (symbols: soft hex,dibit value;...)
 */
public class GenLsm {
    static String hex(float[] a) {
        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
        for (int i = 0; i < a.length; i++) sb.append(i > 0 ? "," : "").append(Integer.toHexString(Float.floatToRawIntBits(a[i])));
        return sb.toString();
    }

    static class StubFramer extends P25P1MessageFramer {
        final StringBuilder log = new StringBuilder();
        @Override public boolean processWithSoftSyncDetect(float soft, Dibit d) {
            log.append(Integer.toHexString(Float.floatToRawIntBits(soft))).append(",").append(d.getValue()).append(";");
            return false;
        }
    }

    static FeedbackDecoder stubDecoder() {
        return new FeedbackDecoder() {
            @Override public String getProtocolDescription() { return "stub"; }
            @Override public DecoderType getDecoderType() { return DecoderType.P25_PHASE1; }
            @Override public void reset() { }
            @Override public void start() { }
            @Override public void stop() { }
            @Override public void dispose() { }
            @Override public void setMessageListener(io.github.dsheirer.sample.Listener<io.github.dsheirer.message.IMessage> l) { }
            @Override public void removeMessageListener() { }
        };
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        PrintWriter out = new PrintWriter(new FileWriter(args[0]));
        double rate = 50000;
        Random rnd = new Random(4242L);

        // Synthetic pi/4-DQPSK: phase steps +pi/4 (+1), +3pi/4 (+3), -pi/4 (-1), -3pi/4 (-3), linear phase ramp
        // across each symbol, 230 Hz carrier offset, amplitude 0.25, gaussian noise.
        int n = 24000;
        int symbols = (int) (n / rate * 4800) + 2;
        double[] phaseAt = new double[symbols + 1];
        double[] steps = {Math.PI / 4, 3 * Math.PI / 4, -Math.PI / 4, -3 * Math.PI / 4};
        for (int s = 1; s <= symbols; s++) phaseAt[s] = phaseAt[s - 1] + steps[rnd.nextInt(4)];
        float[] si = new float[n], sq = new float[n];
        for (int k = 0; k < n; k++) {
            double t = k / rate * 4800;
            int s = (int) Math.floor(t);
            double frac = t - s;
            double ph = phaseAt[s] + (phaseAt[s + 1] - phaseAt[s]) * frac + 2 * Math.PI * 230 * k / rate;
            si[k] = (float) (0.25 * Math.cos(ph) + rnd.nextGaussian() * 0.02);
            sq[k] = (float) (0.25 * Math.sin(ph) + rnd.nextGaussian() * 0.02);
        }

        // P25P1DecoderLSM.setSampleRate(50000): decimation 2 -> 25 kHz.
        IRealDecimationFilter di = DecimationFilterFactory.getRealDecimationFilter(2);
        IRealDecimationFilter dq = DecimationFilterFactory.getRealDecimationFilter(2);
        float decimated = (float) rate / 2;
        float[] rrc = FilterFactory.getRootRaisedCosine(decimated / 4800.0, 16, 0.2f);
        FIRFilterSpecification spec = FIRFilterSpecification.lowPassBuilder().sampleRate(decimated)
            .passBandCutoff(7250).passBandAmplitude(1.0).passBandRipple(0.01)
            .stopBandAmplitude(0.0).stopBandStart(8000).stopBandRipple(0.01).build();
        float[] bb = FilterFactory.getTaps(spec);
        out.println("TAPS|baseband|" + hex(bb));
        out.println("TAPS|rrc|" + hex(rrc));
        IRealFilter psi = FilterFactory.getPulseShapingFilter(rrc), psq = FilterFactory.getPulseShapingFilter(rrc);
        IRealFilter bbi = FilterFactory.getRealFilter(bb), bbq = FilterFactory.getRealFilter(bb);

        StubFramer framer = new StubFramer();
        P25P1DemodulatorLSM demod = new P25P1DemodulatorLSM(framer, stubDecoder());
        demod.setSamplesPerSymbol(decimated / 4800);

        int[] blocks = {2000, 2000, 2000, 2000, 2000, 2000, 2000, 2000, 2000, 2000, 2000, 2000};
        int pos = 0;
        for (int blk : blocks) {
            float[] i = Arrays.copyOfRange(si, pos, pos + blk), q = Arrays.copyOfRange(sq, pos, pos + blk);
            pos += blk;
            float[] fi = di.decimateReal(i), fq = dq.decimateReal(q);
            fi = bbi.filter(fi); fq = bbq.filter(fq);
            fi = psi.filter(fi); fq = psq.filter(fq);
            framer.log.setLength(0);
            demod.process(fi, fq);
            out.println("BLOCK|" + hex(i) + "|" + hex(q) + "|" + framer.log);
        }
        out.close();
    }
}
